Kudṛṣṭidhvāntamārtaṇḍa
reply to criticisms of viś. adv. system. by Raṅgācārya Svāmin of Veṅkaṭagiri.
Pt.. Bombay, 1900. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 556.

Kudṛṣṭinirghāta(na)
Bud. by Advayavajra. Cordier II. p. 213. Nepal II. p.. 13-15.
Pt.. Advayavajrasaṅgraha, GOS. XL. Passages from this found in Buddhaveda (Bud. tantra), “Skt. Texts from Bāli” GOS. LXVII, 1933. (See Intro. by S. Levi, p. xxx.).

Kudṛṣṭinirghātacintā
Bud. by Advayavajra. Cordier II. p. 214. C.. Nepal II. p.. 13-15. (Col. kudRSTinirghAtAdivAkyAnAM TippanIkeyam).

Kudṛṣṭibhaṅga
viś. adv. by (Kandāḍai) Appāgoṇdācārya, son of Appalācārya an. Lakṣmī. MT. 387 (d). 5432.

Kuddālīpāda
Bud. See also Kodhali, Ghadhari below. [Page192-b]
